name: ALFWorld
summary: 将文本任务与室内具身环境对齐的交互基准，提供动作、观测和任务状态轨迹。
summaryEn: An interactive benchmark aligning text tasks with indoor embodied environments and task-state trajectories.
scale: Household multi-step tasks across text and visual settings
scaleZh: 覆盖文本和视觉设置的家庭多步任务
organizationsZh: 华盛顿大学及合作团队
verdict: 文本—视觉具身轨迹基准
wmNote: 任务状态与动作序列支持长期规划模型评测。
wmNoteEn: Task states and action sequences support long-horizon planning evaluation.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2010.03768] ALFWorld: Aligning Text and Embodied Environments for Interactive Learning
evidence.statement: TextWorld actions are aligned to executable ALFRED visual-environment goals, providing interactive state transitions.
